summary:
Fortinet 本季 EPS 大超預期32.6%，營收年增20%，網路安全動能強勁。
• EPS 0.82 美元，大幅超預估0.62（+32.63%）。
• 營收1.85億美元（B級），年增20.13%強勁。
• 防火牆換機週期與 SASE、OT 安全帶動成長。
• 獲利大超預期顯示營運槓桿與利潤率改善。
ai_view:
訊號正面：EPS 大超預期且營收年增20%，反映防火牆換機週期啟動與安全服務（SASE、OT）擴張。短期業績動能強，股價有支撐。中期關鍵在訂閱服務（SecOps、SASE）能否持續抬升經常性收入占比，降低硬體循環波動。追蹤指標：服務營收年增、帳單金額（billings）、SASE/OT 滲透與營業利潤率。57.6倍本益比已反映高預期，需動能延續支撐。

需留意：本益比57.64偏高，估值對成長持續性敏感。；防火牆換機週期具波動性，產品營收起伏大。；網路安全競爭激烈，SASE 領域對手眾多。

summary_en:
Fortinet smashed EPS by 32.6% with 20% revenue growth, on strong cybersecurity momentum.
• EPS of $0.82 beat the $0.62 estimate by 32.63%.
• Revenue of $1.85B grew a strong 20.13% year over year.
• Firewall refresh cycle plus SASE and OT security drive growth.
• A large EPS beat shows operating leverage and margin gains.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a large EPS beat with 20% revenue growth reflects a firewall refresh cycle and expansion in security services (SASE, OT). Near-term momentum is strong and supports the stock. Mid-term the key is whether subscription services (SecOps, SASE) keep lifting the recurring-revenue mix and dampen hardware cyclicality. Track service revenue growth, billings, SASE/OT penetration, and operating margin. A 57.6x P/E embeds high expectations needing sustained momentum.

Watch：A high P/E of 57.64 is sensitive to growth durability.; The firewall refresh cycle is volatile, swinging product revenue.; Intense cybersecurity competition, especially in SASE.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出32.63%，營收年增20.13%表現亮眼。
